Project.title: Project
Project.description: Simulated SENA business plan financial model saved by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this simulated project.

name.description: Display name of the simulated project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated.

inputs.description: Complete structured inputs of steps 1 to 6 of the financial simulator.

diagnosis.description: Optional AI financial diagnosis report generated for the project.

summary.description: Optional cached financial metrics summary (totalInvestment, npv, irr).

/projects/{projectId}.description: Top-level collection storing each user's saved business plan financial simulations, strictly scoped by ownerId.
